explanation: Let P=P_{C\to B}. Since [v]_B=P[v]_C, the transformation matrices satisfy [T]_B=P[T]_C P^{-1}, proving I. The reverse relation is [T]_C=P^{-1}[T]_B P, so III is not generally true. II incorrectly uses the transformation matrix for conjugation and also assumes it is invertible. Thus only I holds generally.
